coverage_note: Bounded source registry, not all funding accessible to Sicilian municipalities. Notices/articles are not necessarily unique grants. Eligibility, deadlines, amendments and invitations need evidence extraction; unknowns must remain visible. National sources require added, verified feeds. Last audited shapes: 2026-10-06.

sources.coverage_note: Official SEDIA current index only, English, types 1/2/8, source-marked open/forthcoming. Excludes procurement and stale CENTRICITY records. Metadata status does not prove a future application deadline or municipal eligibility. Downloads are limited to ec.europa.eu, commission.europa.eu and eur-lex.europa.eu (including their subdomains); external cascade sites are not crawled.

Audited Bandi category union, including closed notices, results and amendments so stale/missing status labels cannot hide opportunities. HTML article attachments are fetched because they are absent from WP content. Not all Regione Sicilia departments, old archives or national ministries; linked landing pages and ZIP contents are not recursively crawled.

Disabled template. Enable and provide notices inline, or replace notices with path (local JSON file) or url (official HTTPS JSON feed). Feed schema is an array, or {notices: [...]}; each entry has id, title, source_url, optional source_text, and documents [{url, optional filename, optional mime_type}]. Explicitly verify and extend allowed_hosts when adding ministries. Source and document links must use HTTPS; no generic scraping or national completeness is implied.
